decisions.decision_needed: Saeed decides: when the reconciliation check finds a mismatch between generated copy and the seller's verified facts, should the product only flag the mismatch for the seller to fix (flag_only), or should it auto fix the generated copy to match the verified facts (auto_fix)? Until he decides, the safe default flag_only stands.
decisions.name: Reconciliation: flag only or auto fix

decisions.decision_needed: Saeed decides: is the trial 7 days, no card, one per account (per_account_7_days_no_card), or should the trial be per listing pack, so a seller trials premium features on one pack at a time (per_listing_pack)? Until he decides, the safe default per_account_7_days_no_card stands, matching the trial in config/plans.json. Changing this flag alone does not build the per pack trial; that is a separate build.
decisions.name: Trial shape: per account or per listing pack

decisions.decision_needed: Saeed decides: should mockups follow the existing plan entitlements, basic mockups on Free and the full library including premium frames on Premium (follow_plan_entitlements), or should all mockups be free for every seller (free_for_all)? Until he decides, the safe default follow_plan_entitlements stands, matching canUseMockup in packages/billing/src/entitlements.ts. Changing this flag alone does not change the gate; that is a separate build.
decisions.name: Mockup pricing: plan entitlements or free for all

note: Admin configurable flags for three open decisions. Each flag holds the safe current default until Saeed decides otherwise. Changing a flag value in this file records the choice; it does not by itself build the alternative behaviour. The alternative behaviour for each flag is a separate build, listed in docs/monetization.md section 10. No price, no VAT rate, and no legal wording is set here.
